rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses accredited by ACPE or the North Carolina Association of Pharmacists; 5 hours for precepting a student from a NC school of pharmacy for at least 160 hours
rules.carryover: Up to 5 surplus hours may be carried forward to the following year.
rules.alternatives: Exempt if eligible for the armed forces extension/waiver (21 NCAC 46 .1613), or if for the whole preceding year the pharmacist lived in another state, did not practice in NC and met that state's CE requirement.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Pharmacists licensed by reciprocity must meet the CE standards within the first renewal period after licensure.
rules.audit_note: CE hours are reported through the Board's online renewal portal; records, reports of accredited hours and certificates must be submitted if audited. Keep records 3 years (a provider's electronic database counts).
rules.notes: 15 hours each year, 5 of them through contact programs with live two-way communication (live online counts). Clinical Pharmacist Practitioners need 35 hours of practice-relevant CE yearly. Reporting: in the Board renewal portal.
